Selection, clipping and triangles

Source: R/ops.R
zl-select.Rd

zl_where(mask, a, b) is mask * a + (1 - mask) * b for a mask of 0s and 1s. zl_clamp() limits values to [lo, hi]. zl_tri() keeps one triangle of each matrix, as lower.tri() and upper.tri() select it, and sets the rest to zero. zl_clamp() and zl_tri() have no gradient.

Usage

zl_where(mask, a, b)

zl_clamp(x, lo, hi)

zl_tri(x, type = c("lower", "upper", "lower_strict", "upper_strict"))

Arguments

mask, a, b, x

Tensors.

lo, hi

Numbers.

type

Which triangle: "lower" and "upper" include the diagonal, the _strict forms do not.

Value

A tensor.

Examples

p <- zl_params()
g <- zl_graph(
  function(x) zl_tri(zl_clamp(x$m, -1, 1), "lower"),
  p,
  inputs = list(m = c(3, 3))
)
zl_forward(g, list(m = matrix(-4:4, 3, 3)))$output
#>      [,1] [,2] [,3]
#> [1,]   -1    0    0
#> [2,]   -1    0    0
#> [3,]   -1    1    1
